text: के कार्ाालर् / Office of एससी/एसटी संपका SC/ST Liaison राष्ट्रीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान कनााटक, सुरत्कल, मंिलूरु-५७५०२५ (राष्ट्रीर् महत्व का संस्थान, एनआईटीएसईआर अधिधनर्म के तहत स्थाधपत, भारत सरकार) National Institute of Technology Karnataka, Surathkal, Mangaluru – 575025 (An Institute of National Importance, Established under NITSER Act, Government of India) दूरभाष / Phone: +91-824-2473024 (O), ई-मेल / E-mail: liaisonofficer_scstcell@nitk.edu.in Notice 22.07.2026 National Scholarship for Higher Education (SC/ST Students) for the Academic Year 2026-27 Applications (Fresh / Renewal) are now open for the National Scholarship for Higher Education for SC/ST students, previously known as the Central Sector Scheme of Top-Class Education for SC/ST Students. This scholarship is available for undergraduate (UG) students whose family annual income from all sources is below Rs. 8 lakhs for SC students and Rs. 6 lakhs for ST students. Closing date of application registration by students (Fresh & Renewal) 31.10.2026. Eligibility Criteria: ▪ SC Students: 13 slots available, based on JEE Main CRL Ranking ▪ ST Students: All eligible ST students can apply Application Process: 1. Online Application: o Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP): www.scholarships.gov.in 2. Required Certificates: o Documents are required to be uploaded on the portal while filling the application online includes Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Fee Receipt (Expenditure Certificate), Bank Passbook copy and Mark Sheet. o Income (current financial year) and Caste certificate in English or Hindi is mandatory. o Bank Passbook copy of the student is valid. 3. Procedure to obtain Expenditure Certificate: o Download the format from the NITK website: NITK Certificates & Transcript o Complete the form with your personal details (Name, Date of Admission, Semester, Branch, etc.). o Submit the completed form to the Academic Section (E7). o You will receive the completed expenditure certificate within 2 days. 4. Submission of Application: o After completing and submitting your application on the NSP portal, print the signed copy. o Submit the signed applic ation along with all supporting documents (Income, caste certificate, Expenditure certificate, Previous year Marks Sheet, Bank Passbook copy) to the SC-ST Cell office. For any queries or additional assistance, please contact the SC-ST Cell office. -Sd- Liaison Officer (SC/ST Cell)
